notes.title: New update released today!
notes.notes:
New update now available! (Patch notes 1.2.0.0)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37954874/307b4cc121e3ab6fc86dea584ec60eed0d1c7f6d.jpg[/img]

[h1]GAMEPLAY UPDATES[/h1]

[list]
[*] Shield with recovery rate added
[*] Visual points of damage in enemies
[/list]

[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]

[list]
[*] FIXED - Camera behavior
[*] FIXED - Navigation in the Elevator Phase
[*] FIXED - Collision added in tires of the Waste Disposal map.
[/list]


[h1]OTHER CHANGES[/h1]

[list]
[*] One more dodge added
[*] Statistics added
[*] New difficulty (Hard mode)
[*] New illustrations of the game, unlocked at boss battles in hard mode
[*] New chibis
[*] New achievements
[*] New bosses attacks (Hard mode) 
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.1.1
notes.notes:
New Combat Tutorial.

Naoi made a checklist for Cyne about the things he needs in battle. Some advices everyone in the Black Mamba Force Operation must know if they want to have a chance to survive.
